name: store-studio
description: Manage App Store Connect and Google Play from Claude Code: upload, reorder and download screenshots for every locale and device, edit store text, upload builds (.ipa on a Mac, .aab anywhere) with staged rollouts, manage TestFlight, and reach every other endpoint of both official APIs (versions, review submissions, phased releases, pricing, reviews, analytics and sales reports, tracks, Data safety) through reference lookup, reads and confirmed writes. Connect accounts in the chat from your downloaded key files, or in the plugin settings; keys stay on your machine.

app_store_key_id.title: App Store Connect: key ID
app_store_key_id.description: Key ID of a Team API key (App Store Connect > Users and Access > Integrations > App Store Connect API). Easier: leave the settings empty and connect the account in the chat by giving the downloaded key file's path.

app_store_issuer_id.title: App Store Connect: issuer ID
app_store_issuer_id.description: The Issuer ID shown above the keys list on the same page.

app_store_private_key.title: App Store Connect: private key (.p8)
app_store_private_key.description: The contents of the AuthKey_XXXXXXXXXX.p8 file. Enter it as one line: this form keeps only the first line of a paste. Kept in your system's secure storage. Easier: leave the settings empty and connect the account in the chat by giving the downloaded key file's path.

google_play_service_account.title: Google Play: service account key (.json)
google_play_service_account.description: The contents of the service account's .json key file. Enter it as one line: this form keeps only the first line of a paste. Kept in your system's secure storage. Easier: leave the settings empty and connect the account in the chat by giving the downloaded key file's path.

app_store_name.title: App Store Connect: account name
app_store_name.description: A short name for this team, such as acme.

google_play_name.title: Google Play: account name
google_play_name.description: A short name for this developer account, such as acme.

app_store_2_key_id.title: App Store Connect, second team: key ID
app_store_2_key_id.description: Only for a second team; leave empty otherwise.

app_store_2_issuer_id.title: App Store Connect, second team: issuer ID
app_store_2_issuer_id.description: Only for a second team; leave empty otherwise.

app_store_2_private_key.title: App Store Connect, second team: private key (.p8)
app_store_2_private_key.description: Only for a second team. Enter it as one line: this form keeps only the first line of a paste. Kept in your system's secure storage.

app_store_2_name.title: App Store Connect, second team: account name
app_store_2_name.description: A short name for the second team.

google_play_2_service_account.title: Google Play, second account: service account key (.json)
google_play_2_service_account.description: Only for a second developer account. Enter it as one line: this form keeps only the first line of a paste. Kept in your system's secure storage.

google_play_2_name.title: Google Play, second account: account name
google_play_2_name.description: A short name for the second developer account.
